subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix branch should be treated as canonical for the `message_sending` agent-reply bypass?
rationale: Current source confirms the bug, but several open PRs cover different subsets of dispatcher and Telegram streaming behavior, so automation should not open another competing fix or choose the permanent hook ownership boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use the complete Telegram-aware branch
options.body: Make the branch that covers configured dispatch plus Telegram preview-finalized delivery the canonical path, then require rebase, real proof, and review of exactly-once semantics.

options.title: Land a narrower dispatcher fix first
options.body: Choose a smaller branch for configured `beforeDeliver` composition and leave streamed Telegram preview-finalized delivery tracked as follow-up work.

options.title: Pause all candidate PRs for design
options.body: Hold the PRs until maintainers define the permanent outbound policy boundary and hook ownership semantics across channels.

recommendation.title: Use the complete Telegram-aware branch
recommendation.body: Make the branch that covers configured dispatch plus Telegram preview-finalized delivery the canonical path, then require rebase, real proof, and review of exactly-once semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight owns the broadest open candidate branch that tries to cover the configured dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final paths together.
